tw-01.note: 長壽 longevity or living a long life (무병장수 long and healthy life) vs 將帥 military commander or general (용감한 장수 brave general). Different hanja roots sharing the same spelling.
기억력 (記憶力) is broad mental recall or retention (기억력이 좋다 good memory), whereas 암기력 (暗記力) is the specific skill of deliberately memorizing words or data (단어 암기력 skill at memorizing vocabulary).
Both mean symptoms, but 증상 (症狀) denotes specific bodily symptoms (기침 증상 cough symptom), while 증세 (症勢) describes the overall trend or severity of illness (증세가 호전되다 condition improves).
기대다 describes both physical leaning (벽에 기대다 lean on a wall) and emotional reliance. 의지하다 is strictly emotional or practical dependence (부모에게 의지하다 rely on parents) and cannot mean physical leaning.

tw-02.note: 年 year or annual period (연 1회 once a year, 연회비 annual fee) vs 鳶 traditional flying kite (연을 날리다 fly a kite). Completely different hanja roots with identical spelling.
寺 Buddhist temple (절에 가다 visit a temple) vs deep ceremonial bow (새해 절을 올리다 perform a New Year bow). Context tells whether it is a sacred place or a bow.

Both mean barely, but 겨우 emphasizes a meager amount or minimal threshold (겨우 세 명 only three people), while 간신히 highlights surviving great difficulty or close failure (간신히 기차를 탔다 barely caught the train).

국립 (國立) institutions are funded and governed directly by the national government (국립박물관 national museum), whereas 공립 (公立) institutions are founded and managed by local cities or provinces (공립학교 public school).

tw-03.note: 香水 bottled perfume or fragrance (향수를 뿌리다 spray perfume) vs 鄕愁 homesickness or nostalgia for one's homeland (향수를 달래다 soothe homesickness). Two different Sino-Korean terms.

묶다 means binding several things together or tying a firm knot (끈으로 상자를 묶다 tie a box with string), while 매다 is used for fastening worn accessories or shoes (넥타이를 매다 wear a necktie, 신발 끈을 매다 tie shoe laces).

Pronounced identically ([집따]). 집다 means picking up an object with fingers or tongs (반찬을 집다 pick up food). 짚다 means leaning on a support (지팡이를 짚다 lean on a cane) or taking body temperature (이마를 짚다 touch one's forehead).
Both can mean paying money (값을 치르다 pay the cost), but 치르다 uniquely extends to going through major life events or trials (시험을 치르다 take an exam, 장례를 치르다 hold a funeral). 지불하다 is strictly financial.

tw-04.note: 時期 appropriate time, season, or period (적절한 시기 the right time) vs 猜忌 jealousy or envy toward others (남을 시기하다 envy someone). Unrelated hanja roots.
철 meaning season (딸기 철 strawberry season) or maturity (철이 들다 become mature) vs 鐵 iron or steel metal (철강 산업 steel industry). Context indicates time, maturity, or metal.

전날 (前날) specifies the single calendar day before a designated event (시험 전날 the day before the test), whereas 지난날 refers broadly to past years or bygone life memories (지난날을 회상하다 reminisce about the past).

tw-05.note: 安心 peace of mind or relief from anxiety (안심하고 쉬다 rest with peace of mind) vs 案心 tenderloin cut of beef or pork (소고기 안심 beef tenderloin). Different hanja origins.

기억 (記憶) is neutral cognitive storage of data or facts (비밀번호 기억 remembering passwords), whereas 추억 (追憶) specifically denotes nostalgic, emotionally cherished life moments (학창 시절의 추억 fond school memories).

아쉽다 expresses mild personal regret when something falls just short (한 점 차로 져서 아쉽다 disappointed to lose by one point), while 안타깝다 conveys deep pity or sorrow for another's misfortune (사고 소식이 안타깝다 feeling sorrow over an accident).

tw-06.note: 고소하다 describes nutty, toasted flavors like sesame oil or roasted nuts (참기름이 고소하다 sesame oil is fragrant). 구수하다 describes deep, hearty aromas like soybean stew or scorched rice (된장찌개가 구수하다), as well as warm rustic speech.
껍질 is soft, pliable peel, rind, or skin of fruits and vegetables (사과 껍질 apple peel). 껍데기 is rigid, hard shell or casing of shellfish, eggs, or nuts (조개 껍데기 clam shell, 달걀 껍데기 eggshell).
양념 refers to blended marinades or spice mixtures for seasoned dishes (고기 양념 meat marinade). 조미료 (調味料) refers to individual seasonings or manufactured flavor additives (화학 조미료 MSG flavoring).
Complementary laundry steps: 널다 is hanging wet wash out on a rack or line to dry (빨래를 널다 hang laundry), while 걷다 is taking down and collecting the dried laundry (마른 빨래를 걷다 take in laundry).

tw-07.note: 演技 theatrical acting or performance (명연기를 펼치다 give a great acting performance) vs 煙氣 visible smoke from combustion (연기가 나다 smoke rises) vs 延期 postponement (경기 연기 match postponement). Three different hanja roots.
詩集 printed anthology of poems (시집을 읽다 read a poetry collection) vs 媤집 married woman's in-law family (시집살이 living with in-laws). Different etymological roots.

상영 (上映) specifically means screening a film in movie theaters (극장에서 영화 상영 screening a film in cinemas), while 방영 (放映) means broadcasting a drama or show on television (방송국에서 드라마 방영 televising a drama).

깔끔하다 highlights spotless cleanliness and refreshing neatness of surroundings or design (깔끔한 방 tidy room), whereas 단정하다 (端正) stresses polite personal grooming, posture, or attire (단정한 옷차림 neat and proper clothes).

tw-08.note: 物價 market prices and cost of living goods (물가 상승 price rise) vs 물가 natural water's edge, shore, or riverbank (물가에서 놀다 play by the waterside). Unrelated word origins.
印象 facial look or impression (첫인상이 좋다 have a good first impression) vs 引上 markup, hike, or increase in rates and prices (요금 인상 fare hike). Different hanja roots.
線 geometric line or wire (선을 긋다 draw a line) vs formal matchmaking meeting arranged for marriage (선을 보다 attend a marriage blind date). Distinct senses separated by context.

강사 (講師) refers broadly to course lecturers and instructors at academies, community centers, or colleges (학원 강사 academy instructor), while 교수 (敎授) is a faculty professor appointed at a university (대학교 교수 university professor).

tw-09.note: 共同 joint, cooperative, or shared public collaboration (공동 연구 joint research) vs 空洞 hollow cavern, physical cavity, or empty hole (동굴의 공동 cavern cavity). Different hanja words sharing pronunciation.

제안 (提案) is putting forward a concrete proposal, initiative, or plan for mutual consideration (신제품 아이디어 제안), whereas 조언 (助言) is offering helpful advice to assist someone with guidance (선배의 따뜻한 조언 senior's warm advice).

추측 (推測) is deducing or guessing about an unverified current or past situation using clues (이유를 추측하다 deduce reasons), while 예상 (豫想) specifically projects future outcomes ahead of time (내일 날씨 예상 forecasting tomorrow's weather).

Both mean advice, but 조언 (助言) provides positive, supportive guidance to help (업무 조언 helpful work tips), while 충고 (忠告) offers direct, stern criticism to correct a mistake or fault (따끔한 충고 stern admonition).

tw-10.note: Both mean prediction, but 예상 (豫想) is a general expectation or anticipation (예상보다 빠르다 faster than expected), whereas 예측 (豫測) is systematic, scientific forecasting based on data and models (기상 예측 meteorological forecast).

권하다 (勸) is warmly offering a drink or inviting someone to try an action (차를 권하다 offer tea, 휴식을 권하다 advise rest). 추천하다 (推薦) is formally nominating or endorsing an item or person (좋은 책을 추천하다 recommend a good book).

사용법 (使用法) focuses on technical operations for using physical devices, tools, or medicines (스마트폰 사용법 phone user guide), while 이용법 (利用法) focuses on accessing public services, facilities, or systems (지하철 이용법 subway transit guide).

tw-11.note: 求하다 seek, look for, or obtain (일자리를 구하다 search for a job) vs 救하다 save, rescue, or relieve from danger (위험에서 아이를 구하다 save a child). Two distinct Hanja verbs.
미루다 is common everyday Korean for putting off chores or decisions (결정을 내일로 미루다). 연기하다 (延期) is formal for officially rescheduling events or meetings (개막식을 다음 주로 연기하다).
Both end in -서 (document), but 보고서 (報告書) reports completed findings or results (출장 보고서 business trip report), while 신청서 (申請書) applies for entry or approval (회원 신청서 application form).
곧장 emphasizes direct physical path without stopping or detours (집으로 곧장 가다 head straight home). 곧바로 focuses on immediate timing with zero delay (도착하자마자 곧바로 연락하다 call right away).

tw-12.note: 早期 early stage or period (암의 조기 진단 early diagnosis of cancer) vs native Korean fish yellow corvina (영광 조기 Yeonggwang corvina fish). Completely different origins.
課長 section chief or department manager in a workplace (인사과 과장 HR manager) vs 誇張 exaggeration or overstatement (과장된 표현 exaggerated expression). Different Hanja roots.
근무 (勤務) refers to serving active working hours or shifts at a specific post (근무 시간 work hours). 근로 (勤勞) refers broadly to economic labor as protected by law (근로 기준법 labor standards act).
주의 (注意) is vigilance or care to avoid risks or errors (주의 사항 precautions). 주목 (注目) is focusing sight or public interest onto a prominent subject (전 세계의 주목 global spotlight).

tw-13.note: 意識 cognitive consciousness or awareness (의식을 되찾다 regain consciousness) vs 儀式 formal ceremony or ritual (입학 의식 entrance ceremony). Two distinct Hanja terms.
負傷 physical injury or trauma (부상을 당하다 get injured) vs 浮上 floating to the surface or rising to prominence (새로운 문제로 부상 emerge as an issue). Unrelated Hanja terms.

구분 (區分) is classifying items into defined sections or partitions (연령대별 구분 sorting by age). 구별 (區別) is discerning the difference between two confusing things (참과 거짓을 구별하다 discern truth from falsehood).

대비 (對比) compares two elements side by side to assess relative ratio or differences (전년 대비 성장률). 대조 (對照) explicitly sets two opposites side by side to expose stark differences (흑백의 대조 contrast of black and white).

tw-14.note: 兆 number trillion (1조 원 one trillion won) vs 組 small group or team (조를 나누다 divide into groups) vs 條 article of a treaty or law (헌법 제1조 Article 1 of Constitution). Different Hanja.
보존 (保存) protects valuable heritage, natural ecosystems, or records from decay or ruin (생태계 보존). 유지 (維持) keeps an ongoing condition, habit, or standard stable over time (체중 유지 weight maintenance).
초대 (招待) is common invitation to personal events or meals (친구를 집에 초대하다). 초청 (招請) is highly formal invitation extended to dignitaries, experts, or state guests (해외 전문가 초청 inviting overseas experts).
숙이다 is tilting downward from the neck or waist (머리를 숙여 인사하다 bow). 굽히다 is flexing joints like knees and elbows (팔을 굽히다 bend arms) or figurative yielding of pride (자존심을 굽히다 swallow pride).

tw-15.note: 古典 time-honored classic book or piece of music (고전 소설 classic novel) vs 苦戰 hard struggle or uphill battle (원정 경기에서 고전하다 struggle in an away match). Different Hanja.

주최 (主催) refers to the sponsoring organization taking responsibility for an event (시청 주최 hosted by city hall). 개최 (開催) refers to the physical staging or opening of the gathering (행사 개최 staging an event).

교체 (交替) replaces worn-out components or personnel with fresh ones (배터리 교체 battery replacement). 교환 (交換) is mutual swapping of things or exchanging purchased items at a store (사이즈 교환 exchange for size).
Antithetical door actions: 당기다 is pulling toward yourself (당기시오 pull), while 밀다 is pushing away (미시오 push). 당기다 also means moving a schedule earlier (시간을 한 시간 당기다).

tw-16.note: 以內 within numerical bounds of time, range, or quantity (일주일 이내 within a week) vs native adverb meaning soon or before long (이내 눈물을 흘렸다 soon shed tears). Context tells them apart.
드디어 expresses positive thrill and relief at an eagerly awaited happy outcome (드디어 도착했다 finally arrived!). 마침내 neutrally recounts the ultimate culmination after prolonged trials (마침내 결론에 도달했다).
시원하다 describes refreshing, pleasant relief from heat (시원한 물 refreshing water). 서늘하다 has an edge of crisp chill that borders on cold (늦가을의 서늘한 바람 crisp chilly wind of late autumn).
Opposite time horizons: 단기 (短期) spans a brief temporary window (단기 연수 short-term training), while 장기 (長期) spans an extensive multi-year duration (장기 대출 long-term loan).

tw-17.note: 소중하다 (所重) emphasizes deeply cherished personal or sentimental value (소중한 가족 precious family). 귀중하다 (貴重) emphasizes objective rarity, utility, or high worth (귀중한 문화유산 valuable cultural heritage).
드러내다 is uncovering what was concealed or hidden from view (진실을 드러내다 reveal the truth). 나타내다 is expressing ideas symbolically or manifesting signs (기호로 나타내다 express in symbols).

신념 (信念) is an overarching philosophical or ethical conviction that guides one's life (굳은 신념 firm belief). 소신 (所信) is an independent personal stance maintained with courage in work or decisions (소신 있는 태도 independent stance).

Contrasting skill proficiencies: 서툴다 is unaccustomed and clumsy at handling tasks (운전이 아직 서툴다 still clumsy at driving), while 능숙하다 (能熟) is highly practiced and fluent (능숙한 외국어 솜씨 fluent foreign language skill).

tw-18.note: 눈길 gaze or glance (사람들의 눈길을 끌다 catch people's eyes) vs 눈길 snow-covered path or road (눈길 운전 driving on snowy roads). Two completely distinct words sharing spelling.

Both mean feeling disappointed or hurt by someone's lacking warmth. 서운하다 focuses on inward emotional disappointment (연락이 없어 서운하다), while 섭섭하다 often accompanies farewells or feeling insufficiently accommodated (작별 인사를 못 해 섭섭하다).

아깝다 focuses on the waste or loss of precious resources, money, or chances (음식을 버리기 아깝다 wasteful to throw away food). 아쉽다 expresses mild sorrow over lack of completeness or missing an ideal chance (다음을 기약하기 아쉽다).

Contrasting stances against adversity: 맞서다 is confronting hardship or opponents face-to-face (어려움에 당당히 맞서다 confront difficulties proudly), while 굴복하다 (屈服) is yielding or surrendering under pressure (위협에 굴복하다 yield to threats).

tw-19.note: 彫刻 three-dimensional sculptural artwork or statue (조각을 감상하다 appreciate a sculpture) vs piece, scrap, or fragment of an object (피자 한 조각 slice of pizza). Different Hanja and origins.

질투 (嫉妬) often arises in personal or romantic relationships fearing displacement (사랑에서 오는 질투). 시기 (猜忌) is cold envy directed toward another person's advantages or success (남의 성공을 시기하다 envy another's success).

공감 (共感) is emotional resonance and empathy for someone's feelings (아픔에 공감하다 empathize with pain). 동감 (同感) is intellectual concurrence with someone's viewpoint or proposal (제 생각도 동감입니다 I agree with that opinion).

깨뜨리다 shatters fragile, brittle materials like glass and pottery, or figurative records (접시를 깨뜨리다 break a dish). 부수다 forcefully demolishes or smashes solid structures and bulky objects (건물을 부수다 tear down a building).

tw-20.note: 調和 harmonious balance or unity (색상의 조화 harmony of colors) vs 造花 artificial faux flowers made of silk or plastic (조화 화환 artificial flower wreath). Completely different Hanja.
讀者 reader or subscriber of written works (책의 애독자 avid reader of a book) vs 獨子 only son in a family lineage (삼대 독자 only son for three generations). Context easily resolves meaning.
童話 children's story or fairy tale (동화 구연 fairy tale storytelling) vs 同化 cultural or biological assimilation (사회에의 동화 assimilation into society). Distinct Hanja terms.

장식하다 (裝飾) specifically attaches ornaments or accessories to embellish something physically (리본으로 상자를 장식하다). 꾸미다 broadly covers beautifying spaces, personal styling, as well as plotting or fabricating stories (계략을 꾸미다 hatch a plot).
